Description: Pin is a two-state button web component that toggles between a pinned and an unpinned status. Status is reflected as a DOM attribute and emitted through public semantic events.

template.description: The HTML template for the pin component.

div.icon.description: The main container of the pin component, styled as a button. Hosts the SVG icon variants and receives the click gesture.

svg.pinned.description: The SVG icon shown when status is 'pinned'.

svg.unpinned.description: The SVG icon shown when status is 'unpinned'.

status.description: The pinned or unpinned status of the component. Compulsory attribute-backed state — the attribute is always present in the DOM and always reflects the current status.

onpin.description: Dispatched when status changes from 'unpinned' to 'pinned'.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Contains the new status of the component.

status.description: The accepted status after the transition.

onunpin.description: Dispatched when status changes from 'pinned' to 'unpinned'.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Contains the new status of the component.

status.description: The accepted status after the transition.

click.description: Toggles the status when the icon container is clicked.

hover.description: Visual feedback when the icon container is hovered.

focus.description: Visual feedback when the icon container receives keyboard focus.
